lines.text: Woe to those who plot evil on their beds and carry it out at morning's light, seizing fields and houses.
The LORD plans a disaster against this nation, and people will taunt them with a bitter lamentation.
His people have risen up like an enemy, stripping splendid robes from passersby and driving women from their pleasant homes.
A lying man of wind preaching of wine would suit this people, but the LORD will gather the remnant like goats in a pen.
One who breaks open the way goes up before them, and they break through the gate with the LORD as their leader.
